thread:
Chad: Hey team — customers behind a gRPC-web gateway are getting partial SSEs then reconnect loops. Browser clients see 2-3 events, then the connection drops and the client reconnects with Last-Event-ID, but the edge logs show the original backend request terminated with a 502 from the gateway. Happening in multiple regions. Any quick theories? :confused:

Ana Support: Thanks Chad. Can you paste a repro curl or client snippet and the headers from the edge? Also tell us whether these clients speak HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1 to our frontend — that matters for translation behavior.

Chad: Majority are browsers (HTTP/1.1 to our frontend) but some internal services use http2 prior-knowledge. Quick curl we used:

```
curl --http2-prior-knowledge -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://api.example.com/v1/stream?prompt=test"
```

We get the stream start, 2-3 SSE messages, then gateway returns `502` and connection closes.

Liam SRE: Two things to suspect: (1) intermediary buffer/timeouts closing idle streaming connections, (2) frame/chunk translation problems when H2 -> H1 conversion coalesces chunks or rewrites trailers. Any upstream logs showing `upstream prematurely closed connection` or `UC` flags?

Maria Runtime: Also check Transfer-Encoding vs Content-Length. SSE expects chunked framing and frequent flushes. If a gateway translates HTTP/2 DATA frames into HTTP/1.1 and coalesces them into a single chunk or adds Content-Length, clients can see truncated last events.

Chad: We grabbed envoy access logs — saw `response_flag` set to `UC` and `upstream_response_time` spike when the drop happened. Gateway team says it's a gRPC-web gateway converting gRPC -> grpc-web -> http1 for some downstreams.

Ana Support: gRPC-web bridges are known to mangle streaming frames. Two quick checks: 1) bypass the translation (http2 passthrough) to see if the issue stops, 2) add a server heartbeat comment every 10-15s like `: heartbeat\n\n` to keep proxies from idling out.

Liam SRE: Also check proxy buffer settings: for nginx set `proxy_buffering off;` and bump `proxy_read_timeout`. For Envoy check `stream_idle_timeout` and `max_connection_duration`, and ensure any buffer limits won't coalesce small writes.

Maria Runtime: Here's the minimal node SSE server we use to reproduce — it forces flush after every event:

```
res.writeHead(200, {
  'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
  'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
  'Connection': 'keep-alive',
});

function send(id, payload) {
  res.write(`id: ${id}\n`);
  res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`);
  res.flush && res.flush();
}

setInterval(() => send(Date.now(), {ok:true}), 1000);
```

Chad: We tried flush() but gateway still coalesces/chunks into a single long http1 chunk and later returns 502.

Ana Support: Can you capture a raw TCP/hex dump to inspect actual chunk boundaries? `curl -v --http2-prior-knowledge -N ...` may show internal framing stops. Also check if the gateway is inserting `Content-Length` — if it does, downstream will treat the body as complete and may close early.

Liam SRE: Another common pitfall is response compression. If the gateway enables gzip, it'll buffer to compress which defeats streaming semantics. Make sure compression is disabled for SSE endpoints.

Chad: We found some truncated responses from the gateway that had `content-length` present and `transfer-encoding` missing. Gateway team is digging into their config.

Maria Runtime: Short-term mitigations we recommend for customers: (a) send a lightweight SSE comment heartbeat every 10s (`: keepalive\n\n`), (b) disable compression on SSE route, (c) set buffering hints such as `X-Accel-Buffering: no` or `X-Envoy-Buffering: 0` if the gateway respects them.

Ana Support: Opening an internal ticket to coordinate eng-runtime and eng-sre. Action items: eng-runtime to publish a canonical repro server that writes tiny chunks and explicitly flushes for both h2 and h1; eng-sre to run a proxy matrix (nginx, envoy gRPC-web, HAProxy) capturing chunk boundaries; support to coordinate with customer and the gateway vendor.

Liam SRE: Also verify whether our rate-limiter or an internal middleware returns a synthetic 502 when it sees the backend reset — sometimes we close backend conns early on 4xx/5xx and send 502 to client which triggers immediate reconnects. Correlate access logs with incoming reconnects using Last-Event-ID header.

gateway-team: We've started inspecting our grpc-web transform. Early note: our bridge was buffering until it saw a final END_STREAM or trailer, then emitting a `Content-Length` by mistake. That explains the truncation. We're testing a config change to preserve chunked streaming.

Chad: Impact is small (~1% requests) but spikes with long responses. We'll attach gateway debug logs and a pcap to the ticket. Happy to share access to a staging token for repro.

Maria Runtime: Dropping an envoy config snippet that helps preserve streaming:

```
http_connection_manager:
  use_remote_address: true
  stream_idle_timeout: 0s
  allow_extended_connect: true
```

Ana Support: Marking this high priority and looping in oncall. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: deploy status: eng-runtime/repro-server v1.2 deployed to staging (sha: a1b2c3). Logs: https://staging.logs/repro-server

Liam SRE: Once repro is up I'll run the proxy matrix and post raw hex dumps of chunk boundaries here for comparison.

Chad: Thanks all — standing by with gateway logs and pcap. :pray:
